### priority_rules
# P1: service-impacting emergencies
if contains "outage" -> P1
if contains "data loss" -> P1
if contains "data breach" -> P1
if contains "security breach" -> P1
if contains "service down" -> P1
if contains "production down" -> P1

# P2: specific money problems (generic billing tickets default to P3)
if contains "double charge" -> P2
if contains "duplicate charge" -> P2
if contains "charged twice" -> P2
if contains "overcharg" -> P2
if contains "unauthorized charge" -> P2
if contains "refund" and not contains "question" -> P2

# P2: specific delivery problems (generic shipping tickets default to P3)
if contains "never arrived" -> P2
if contains "lost package" -> P2
if contains "damaged" and queue == shipping and not contains "question" -> P2
if contains "not delivered" and not contains "question" -> P2

# P2: account access blocked, especially when urgent or business-critical
if queue == account and contains "locked out" -> P2
if queue == account and contains "nobody can" -> P2
if queue == account and contains "urgent" -> P2
if queue == account and contains "demo" and not contains "question" -> P2
if queue == account and contains "admin" and not contains "question" -> P2

# P2: urgent non-general issues that are not questions
if contains "urgent" and not contains "question" and queue != general -> P2

# Everything else
default -> P3
